name: claude-plugin-guidance
description: Opinionated conventions and shared activation checks for authoring Claude Code plugin marketplaces.

plugins.name: guidance-conventions
plugins.description: Opinionated conventions for authoring Claude Code plugin marketplaces, in addition to the official plugin/marketplace standard.

plugins.name: guidance-activation-check
plugins.description: Authoring check for a concept realization inside a plugin marketplace repository, validating its test configuration against the realization's published config schema. It does nothing outside a marketplace repository.
